versions.subject: Redcannary windows test
versions.detection:
selection:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - Test-NetConnection
        - '-ComputerName '
        - '-port '
filter :
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - ' 443 '
        - ' 80 '
condition: selection and not filter
